policy.source_reference: data/Document 2 — Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 (Markdown).md

clauses.text: Section 2.1: Five-minute free wait from scheduled pickup time. Early arrival earns no pre-schedule credit. Implementation interpretation: a late driver must also spend five physical minutes at pickup after arrival.
Section 2.2: A valid driver-cancelled rider no-show incurs SGD 5.00, transferred to the driver as compensation.
Section 2.3: Before cancellation, driver must send at least one in-app chat message AND attempt at least one in-app phone call. Failure of either obligation voids the fee.

Section 2.4: Driver must arrive by scheduled pickup plus 5 minutes. Rider may cancel at no charge when driver fails this arrival condition. Driver no-show plus no contact qualifies for a separate SGD 5 goodwill credit.
Section 2.5: At least 3 no-show cancellations within a rolling 30 days flag the rider for human account review; do not suspend accounts or infer fee validity from history.

Precedent 7.3, DISP-2026-0211: Driver waited 6 minutes but made no message or call. SGD 5 cancellation fee reversed. Relevant when contact obligations are missing; it is not the answer label for the current case.
Section 5.1–5.2: Safety indicators in any dispute require immediate human review. AI must not issue rulings, assign fault, or recommend a resolution for safety incidents.
Section 6.1: Dispute value under SGD 10 permits any confidence; SGD 10–50 needs at least 80%; above SGD 50 requires human review.
Section 6.2: Route AI rulings require confidence >=80% and additional distance <=2 km. No-show/cancellation fee is fixed at SGD 5; safety is always escalated. Unsupported categories are referred.

Section 6.3: Confidence considers evidence completeness, policy clarity, precedent alignment and credibility. Any party fraud flag >=1 raises the confidence requirement to 95%; a flag does not establish fault.

output.purpose: To retrieve call logs, chat history, GPS arrival times, and trip metadata to verify driver compliance with contact obligations and arrival deadlines under the no-show policy.

Retrieve full interaction history to verify if the driver sent required in-app chat messages and attempted phone calls per policy 2.3, confirm arrival time against scheduled pickup per policy 2.4, and establish trip details to determine fee validity.

claims.statement: The SGD 5.00 cancellation fee must be refunded because the driver failed to satisfy the mandatory contact requirements under POLICY-2.3. Although the driver sent one message (FACT-003), the contact log shows zero call attempts (FACT-004), which voids the fee eligibility entirely (FACT-002).
The driver arrived at the scheduled time and maintained verified presence for 6.5 minutes, satisfying the arrival and waiting requirements.
The driver fulfilled the message obligation by sending one in-app chat prior to cancellation, which is a required component of the contact rule.
The ride is confirmed as a valid no-show entitling the driver to compensation, despite the lack of call records which would otherwise void the fee.

counterpoints.statement: The rider's allegation that they never received a call is unsupported by server logs which indicate zero call attempts were made by the driver.

result.explanation: The dispute concerns a no-show charge where the driver failed to satisfy the mandatory contact obligations. POLICY-2.3 requires the driver to send at least one in-app message AND attempt at least one in-app phone call before cancellation. The server logs (FACT-004) confirm zero call attempts were made. Under POLICY-2.3, the failure of either obligation voids the fee. This aligns with Precedent 7.3 (POLICY-7.3), where a SGD 5 fee was reversed due to missing contact. The driver's timely arrival and wait time (POLICY-2.1) do not cure the lack of required contact. The rider's claim for a refund is validated. The rider's complaint about the phone not ringing is unsupported by server logs showing no calls were attempted, so no separate goodwill credit is triggered (POLICY-2.4 goodwill applies to driver no-show with no contact, but here the driver was present; the lack of contact voids the fee, it doesn't constitute a driver no-show for goodwill purposes). The fee is reversed.
